verdict.rationale: Firebase's own Local Emulator Suite gives an isolated environment for integration testing without touching production data. Gemini in Firebase can generate schemas, and the MCP server lets agents work with Firestore and SQL Connect data, so pieces of the story exist as first-party capabilities. Nothing documents an agent creating and validating schema changes in an isolated branch or preview environment, and the emulator is a local sandbox rather than a database branch or preview deployment. missing for 10: database branching or preview environments, a documented agent workflow for applying and testing schema migrations in isolation, evidence that the MCP server can drive emulators or migrations, a promotion path from the test environment to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent create and test schema changes in an isolated branch or preview environment before production

citations.quote: you can connect your app directly to these emulators to perform integration testing or QA without touching production data
Use Gemini in Firebase to generate schemas, queries, and mutations on-demand using natural language.
Work with data in Cloud Firestore and Firebase SQL Connect
